solutionSql:
WITH per_customer AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         COUNT(*)::integer AS shipments
  FROM shipments
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id,
       shipments
FROM per_customer
WHERE shipments >= 30
ORDER BY customer_id;
notes: Each of customers 1 to 6 has exactly 40 shipments, so the 30 threshold does not separate anything in the sample, and customers 7 and 8 have none. Hidden datasets need customers on both sides of the threshold to test it.
